## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.5`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/useVueRenderReturn`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**error**](/reference/diagnostics#error).
- This rule belongs to the following domains:
  - [`vue`](/linter/domains#vue)
- Sources: 
  - Inspired from [`vue/require-render-return`](https://eslint.vuejs.org/rules/require-render-return)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"useVueRenderReturn": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Require the `render` function of a Vue component to return a value.

A `render` function describes what a component displays, and Vue uses the value it
returns. When the function ends without a `return` statement, or uses `return;` without
a value, the component renders nothing.

The rule reports a `render` function when at least one way through the function
ends without returning a value.

## Examples

### Invalid

```vue
<script>
import { h } from "vue";

export default {
  render() {
    if (this.visible) {
      return h("div", "hello");
    }
  },
};
</script>
```

### Valid

```vue
<script>
import { h } from "vue";

export default {
  render() {
    if (this.visible) {
      return h("div", "hello");
    }
    return null;
  },
};
</script>
```
